ko.title: 장3화음
ko.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[CEG]4 |
```

C를 근음으로 한 3개 음을 동시에 울립니다. 근음에서의 반음 거리는 0 · 4 · 7입니다. 이 예시는 기본위치이며 전위하면 가장 낮은 음이 달라집니다.

### 구성음을 비교하기

C–E–G를 아래에서 나누어 보면 C–E는 4반음, E–G는 3반음이다. 근음에서의 거리 0·4·7과 이웃한 음 사이의 거리 4·3은 같은 구조를 다르게 표현한다. E만 E♭로 낮추고 나머지를 그대로 두면 단3화음이 된다. 두 카드를 번갈아 들으며 무엇이 달라졌는지 찾아보면 이름과 구성음을 연결하기 쉽다. 장3화음이 모든 음악에서 같은 감정을 만든다고 정할 필요는 없다.

### 들어 보기

함께 울리는 음의 간격을 들어 보세요. 장·단3화음은 가운데 음 하나가 반음 달라집니다.

en-US.title: Major triad
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[CEG]4 |
```

3 notes sound together above root C. Their semitone distances from the root are 0 · 4 · 7. This is root position; inversions place a different chord tone in the bass.

### Comparing chord tones

Break C–E–G into adjacent gaps: C–E spans four semitones and E–G spans three. Root-relative positions 0·4·7 and adjacent gaps 4·3 describe the same structure from different viewpoints. Lower only E to E-flat and the result is a minor triad. Comparing those cards helps connect the label with the changed chord tone, without assuming that a major triad produces one fixed emotion in every musical context.

### Listen for

Listen to the combined sound. Major and minor triads differ by one semitone in the middle note.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.
en-US.summary: A 3-note chord with tones 0, 4, 7 semitones above its root

ja.title: 長三和音
ja.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[CEG]4 |
```

Cを根音として3音を同時に鳴らします。根音からの半音距離は0 · 4 · 7です。この例は基本形で、転回すると最低音が変わります。

### 構成音を比べる

C–E–Gを隣り合う間隔に分けると、C–Eは4半音、E–Gは3半音になる。根音からの位置0・4・7と隣接間隔4・3は、同じ構造の別の表し方である。EだけをE♭へ下げれば短三和音になる。二つのカードを聴き比べると名称と構成音がつながるが、長三和音がどの音楽でも同じ感情を生むと決める必要はない。

### 聴くポイント

同時に鳴る音の響きを聴きましょう。長三和音と短三和音では中央の音が半音違います。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。
ja.summary: 根音から0·4·7半音の位置にある3音を同時に鳴らす構成

zh-TW.title: 大三和弦
zh-TW.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[CEG]4 |
```

以C為根音，3個音同時發聲。各音距根音的半音數為0 · 4 · 7。本例為原位；轉位會改變最低音。

### 比較和弦構成音

把C–E–G拆成相鄰間距，C–E為4半音，E–G為3半音。從根音算的0、4、7與相鄰間距4、3，是同一結構的不同表示。只把E降成E♭，就成為小三和弦。交替聽兩張卡，能把名稱連到改變的構成音，不必假定大三和弦在所有脈絡都產生固定情緒。

### 聆聽重點

聆聽各音同時發聲的音響。大、小三和弦的中間音僅相差半音。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。
zh-TW.summary: 由根音上方0·4·7半音位置的3個音同時發聲的組成

en-US.title: Minor triad
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[C_EG]4 |
```

3 notes sound together above root C. Their semitone distances from the root are 0 · 3 · 7. This is root position; inversions place a different chord tone in the bass.

### Comparing chord tones

C–E-flat–G has adjacent gaps of three and then four semitones. Compared with the major triad, C and the perfect fifth G stay fixed while the third changes. “Minor” here does not mean every pitch is lowered or the sound is quieter. Placing E-flat in the bass while retaining these chord tones gives an inversion of the C minor triad. Distinguish chord quality from which member happens to be lowest.

### Listen for

Listen to the combined sound. Major and minor triads differ by one semitone in the middle note.

en-US.title: Diminished triad
en-US.description:
```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
[C_E_G]4 |
```

3 notes sound together above root C. Their semitone distances from the root are 0 · 3 · 6. This is root position; inversions place a different chord tone in the bass.

### Comparing chord tones

C–E-flat and E-flat–G-flat are both minor thirds, giving stacked gaps of three plus three semitones. The outer C–G-flat interval is a diminished fifth spanning six. Compare it with C minor: lowering G to G-flat changes the fifth while E-flat stays in place. “Diminished” describes interval structure, not reduced loudness. How the chord proceeds depends on key and surrounding harmony rather than on this isolated sound alone.

### Listen for

Listen to the combined sound. Major and minor triads differ by one semitone in the middle note.
